invariants.rationale: AssetManager is used to construct AssetManagerAtlasResolver, so it must not be null.
tmjFile is passed to getAtlasFileHandle and loadTiledMap, so it is dereferenced.
atlasHandle, assigned from getAtlasFileHandle(tmjFile), is used in further calls.
fileName is typically non-null when loading resources, even if not used directly here.
atlasResolver is assigned a new AssetManagerAtlasResolver in this method.
